mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id AS projectId, event_id AS eventId, template_id AS templateId, COALESCE(report_title, CONCAT('Report #', id)) AS reportName, report_title AS reportTitle, report_type AS reportType, content_html AS contentHtml, content_text AS contentText, docx_url AS docxUrl, pdf_url AS pdfUrl, report_url AS reportUrl, report_hash AS reportHash, metadata_json AS metadataJson, generated_at AS generatedAt, status FROM em_report_instance WHERE (#{projectId} IS NULL OR project_id = #{projectId}) ORDER BY COALESCE(generated_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, project_id AS projectId, event_id AS eventId, template_id AS templateId, COALESCE(report_title, CONCAT('Report #', id)) AS reportName, report_title AS reportTitle, report_type AS reportType, content_html AS contentHtml, content_text AS contentText, docx_url AS docxUrl, pdf_url AS pdfUrl, report_url AS reportUrl, report_hash AS reportHash, metadata_json AS metadataJson, generated_at AS generatedAt, status FROM em_report_instance WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update:
UPDATE em_report_instance SET
docx_url = #{downloadUrl},
pdf_url = #{downloadUrl},
report_url = #{downloadUrl}, report_hash = #{hash}, status = 'generated', generated_at = COALESCE(generated_at, #{generatedAt}), metadata_json = JSON_SET(COALESCE(metadata_json, JSON_OBJECT()), '$.artifactHashAlgorithm', 'SHA-256', '$.lastGeneratedFormat', #{format}) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO em_evidence_resource (project_id, station_id, resource_type, resource_url, captured_at, source_record_key, hash_value, metadata_json) SELECT r.project_id, NULL, 'report', COALESCE(r.report_url, r.pdf_url, r.docx_url), COALESCE(r.generated_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), CONCAT('report_instance:', r.id), r.report_hash, JSON_OBJECT('reportType', r.report_type, 'status', r.status, 'source', 'em_report_instance', 'engineeringSnapshot', JSON_EXTRACT(ev.calculation_snapshot_json, '$')) FROM em_report_instance r LEFT JOIN em_monitoring_event ev ON ev.id=r.event_id WHERE r.id = #{reportId} AND COALESCE(r.report_url, r.pdf_url, r.docx_url) IS NOT NULL ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE resource_url = VALUES(resource_url), captured_at = VALUES(captured_at), hash_value = VALUES(hash_value), metadata_json = VALUES(metadata_json)

INSERT INTO em_event_evidence_link (event_id, evidence_id, link_type, confidence, remark) SELECT r.event_id, e.id, 'report', 1.0000, 'Generated report archived as event evidence' FROM em_report_instance r JOIN em_evidence_resource e ON e.project_id = r.project_id AND e.source_record_key = CONCAT('report_instance:', r.id) WHERE r.id = #{reportId} AND r.event_id IS NOT NULL ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE link_type = VALUES(link_type), confidence = VALUES(confidence), remark = VALUES(remark)
